Bookings and Availability
Welcome to Auas Safari Lodge
Less than an hour’s drive from Hosea Kutako Airport lies a piece of paradise in the shade of the Auas Mountains. Fourteen well-appointed standard rooms  and 3 Luxury rooms each with en-suite bathrooms and private terraces offer respite after a long flight or a hard week’s work. Early evenings are spent sipping drinks on the veranda as the sun sets over the African savannah. The abundant bird and animal species provide endless opportunities for capturing striking photographs. Sunbathing by the heated pool is perfect for relaxation.
News

Our Fathers Day Special
Discover & Experiences
Explore the wildlife, relax by the pool, or enjoy the savannah views.
Game Drive
Encounter giraffes, zebras, antelopes and more on our private reserve.
Spa
Indulge in soothing treatments and unwind in a tranquil atmosphere – the perfect place to relax, recharge, and nourish your well-being.
Enjoy the Pool
Lounge by the heated pool, enjoy the mountain view, or sip a sundowner in peace.
Stay in Comfort
Spacious rooms with private terraces, ensuite bathrooms, our new deck and stunning views of the Namibian bushveld.
Find Us
Conveniently located just 1 hour south of Windhoek or 1 hour from the Hosea Kutako International Airport — the ideal start or end point for your Namibian adventure.

Our Rooms
Choose your perfect stay — from elegant luxury rooms to spacious family units and cozy standard rooms.

+264 61 240043

Luxury Rooms
Stylish comfort with terraces and panoramic views — perfect for couples or solo travelers seeking serenity.
All our Luxury Rooms are air-conditioned for your comfort.
Family Units
Spacious units with two bedrooms, shared lounge, and patios — ideal for families exploring Namibia together.
All our Family Units are air-conditioned for your comfort.
Standart Rooms
Comfortable and practical, our standard rooms offer everything you need for a restful stay at the lodge.
All our Standart Rooms are air-conditioned for your comfort.
Honeymoon
Our Honeymoon Room offers a romantic retreat for couples, featuring a private terrace, elegant décor and beautiful views over the surrounding savannah. Perfect for a peaceful and unforgettable stay in the African wilderness.
Our Honeymoon Room is air-conditioned for your comfort.
Luxury Premium Rooms
Spacious luxury rooms with a large terrace. Direct view of the waterhole, the sunset and the Auas Mountains.
All our Luxury Premium Rooms are air-conditioned for your comfort.

More About Auas Safari Lodge
Where Nature, Comfort & Namibian Warmth Meet
Welcome to Auas Safari Lodge
Less than an hour’s drive from Hosea Kutako Airport lies a piece of paradise in the shade of the Auas Mountains.
Fourteen well-appointed luxury rooms with en-suite bathrooms and private terraces offer respite after a long flight or a hard week’s work.
Early evenings are spent sipping drinks on the veranda as the sun sets over the African savannah. While you watch wildlife at the waterhole nearby, our chefs prepare meals that will take diners on a culinary journey.
The abundant bird and animal species provide endless opportunities for capturing striking photographs. Sunbathing by the pool is perfect for relaxation.
Auas Safari Lodge is a hidden jewel in the heart of Namibia welcoming all travelers.
Transfers
